About Us

## Empowering every marketer to create

![img-company-hero-desktop](https://images.ctfassets.net/x690ow8339ug/25NI9u3kYg4XMYZNZECgQy/5d119a622e24f4b64e55d17b81a982a7/img-company-hero-960x468_.png)

Inspired by how the printing press democratized storytelling, founder and CEO Abhay Parasnis launched Typeface to solve a modern marketing paradox: helping every marketer create personalized, on-brand campaigns alongside AI.

Our Story

# Pioneering the future of marketing

![elevate-freedom-desktop](https://images.ctfassets.net/x690ow8339ug/4yJJpLPg6FgHSwaQdnJSIZ/5c80208d8f561c2112bb44381bbeec74/elevate_freedom_desktop_eb4039832d.png)

Today, Typeface is the Marketing Orchestration Engine for the world's leading enterprises, bringing together brand intelligence, AI agents, and enterprise systems in one governed platform, deeply integrated with Salesforce, Microsoft, Google, and the broader marketing ecosystem.

Our Values

## What we stand for

1. 01

### We push boundaries on what's possible


We explore uncharted territory at the intersection of art and science. We strive to revolutionize content, amplifying human creativity with cutting-edge AI.

2. 02

### We want to give everyone creative confidence


We believe technology is a creative partner that makes the expression of ideas exponentially easier. Everyone has the opportunity to bring their ideas to life.

3. 03

### We put authenticity at our core


Expression is personal. That's why we stay true to ourselves in everything we do - from what we build to how we build it to the way we engage with others.

4. 04

### We approach AI ethically and responsibly


AI is the next major technological shift in how we create. To harness this breakthrough in a safe way, we are committed to evolving AI responsibly.

5. 05

### We embrace a growth mindset to learning


We approach each situation with a curious perspective. We strive to be hungry, humble, and actively listen to our customers for opportunities to innovate.

CAREERS

## Come help us revolutionize the way people create

Our founding team has a proven track record of developing revolutionary, long-lasting AI, SaaS, and media technologies. We're looking for passionate individuals who are committed to exploring new frontiers in AI and are eager to innovate in this exciting space. With offices in Palo Alto, USA; Bellevue, USA; and Hyderabad, India, we’re building a global team. If you're driven to push the limits of what's possible, we'd love to have you join us.

[See open positions](https://www.typeface.ai/careers)

![Company-page_Careers Image.png](https://images.ctfassets.net/x690ow8339ug/58wbiaKOPBe5GxhgyBWLCM/a380ac4917188a4072cfe84e06535d47/Company_page_Careers_Image_08635ca2bf.png)

Did you know?

## Behind the Logo

Our logo mark is inspired by the blinking cursor: the universal symbol of possibility. It represents the moment before creation begins: a blank canvas full of potential. Paired with the Typeface wordmark, it embodies where imagination meets execution. More than a logo, it's a reminder that every story, campaign, and breakthrough starts with a single idea.

![img-company-behind the logo-body-468x468](https://images.ctfassets.net/x690ow8339ug/PGaEocoXSI0MHHdsloLoU/82e9d4c18ccdfff170676bdfef02027f/img-company-behind_the_logo-body-468x468_.png)
